definition: Clinical guidelines for dietary protein intake, focusing on preservation of lean mass during calorie deficits and kidney safety.

scientificReferences.publication: International Society of Sports Nutrition Position Stand: protein and exercise

formulas.name: Maintenance Protein Target
limitations: May overestimate for individuals with BMI > 30

recommendations.title: Optimize Protein for Lean Mass
recommendations.description: Increase daily protein intake to approximately 1.6g per kg of body weight.
expectedBenefits: Preserves muscle mass during fat loss

recommendations.title: Kidney-Safe Protein Strategy
recommendations.description: Maintain a moderate protein intake of 0.8-1.0g per kg of body weight to protect kidney function.

contraindications.reasoning: High protein diets are contraindicated for patients reporting kidney disease or impaired renal function.
